# Syclops — referral management software

Syclops (https://syclops.in) is referral management software for teams in India that grow through people who refer and staff who visit, and then keep customers on a plan. It is used by gyms, campuses, sales teams, fintech, medtech, and the hospitals and clinics it was first built for.

The product joins three things on one record: the field visit, the referral, and the membership plan with its payments.

## How referrals work

Each referral keeps the name of the person who sent it. The sender can be a member, an alumnus, a parent, a teacher, a clinic, a KOL, a DSA, or a channel partner.

Referrers get their own login at app.syclops.in or in the Android app, and sign in with their email and a one-time code. They send people from there and see the status of each person they sent. Referrer logins are not billed as seats.

A referral starts as pending. Your team moves it to arrived, or admitted where that applies, or records why it stopped: not able to contact, did not visit, or went elsewhere. When the person buys, your team records a conversion (planned, converted, or cancelled) with the quoted and the final amount. The referrer sees the referral status; conversions are staff records.

The same mobile number cannot be referred twice. Different spellings of one referrer's name can be merged into one person.

Syclops does not calculate or pay referral rewards. An admin can record a rewarded amount on a referral; the payment itself happens outside Syclops.

## Field visits and TA/DA

Field staff start the working day in the app and check in at each visit with GPS and a photo stamped with the place and time. Visits can be planned in a calendar and on a route, and managers can see which partners have never been visited and which are visited but never refer. Daily reports export to PDF.

TA/DA is worked out from the distance travelled during the working day, using the allowance set for each distance range. Location is recorded only during the working day.

## Membership plans and payments

Our team sets up your membership plans with you. Staff enroll customers from the phone and take payment online through Razorpay, or record cash and UPI payments, including part payments in cash. Your team marks each plan as active or payment due, and a plan with a payment due can be followed up with a field visit. Each plan keeps the name of the person who enrolled the customer.

## Leads and calls

Sales teams log each call with its outcome, keep each lead at a stage such as new, engaged, or closed (lost), and record each win as a conversion with the quoted and final amount.

## Integrations

WhatsApp Business (templates, campaigns, a shared inbox, and delivery reports), Razorpay for online plan payments, and Google Maps. On Scale, a hospital system (HIS) sync is scoped on a call. TA/DA, visit, sales, and referral reports export to Excel.

## Who it is for

- Gyms: members refer friends, trainers visit, and memberships with a payment due are followed up.
- Education: counselor visits, parent and alumni referrals, admissions, and fees that are due.
- Sales: channel partners and field visits on one record, not a source field in a CRM.
- Fintech: agent visits, customer and DSA referrals, and each policy or loan closed.
- Medtech: KOL visits, the introductions they lead to, and each sale.
- Healthcare: referral doctors, PRO visits, and patient referrals from pending to admitted.

## How it differs

WhatsApp and Excel hide the link between a visit, an introduction, and a plan. GPS-only tools prove a location and stop there. A CRM stores a source field, not the partner who sent the lead or the field visit behind it. Gym, school, or clinic software often handles billing well but rarely runs a field team or gives referrers their own login.

## Pricing

Billed in rupees per field seat per month. People who only refer are not billed.

- Team — ₹1,499: field tracking, TA/DA and routes, a referral workspace, up to 3 managers, WhatsApp and Maps.
- Growth — ₹2,499: Team, plus membership plans with cash, UPI and Razorpay, leads with call outcomes and conversions, analytics by referrer and region, and a referral page for referring clinics.
- Scale — ₹4,499: Growth, plus regions and territories for large teams, cluster leaders who see their own region, a hospital system (HIS) sync scoped on a call, and setup with our team on a call.

14 days free, no card. Starting does not need a sales call. Create a workspace at https://syclops.in/start.
